#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
cd /home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listindex-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin || exit 1
task_phase=${1:?before or after required}
case "$task_phase" in
 before) task_source=build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-properties05-before.cpp; task_expected_status=1; task_expected_failures=5;;
 after) task_source=tests/test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_functions_properties_05.cpp; task_expected_status=0; task_expected_failures=0;;
 *) exit 2;;
esac
export TMPDIR=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listindex-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin/build/listindex-tmp
export COPPERFIN_LOCALE_DIR=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listindex-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin/resources/locales
for task_compiler in gcc clang; do
 task_build="build/listindex-$task_compiler"
 if test "$task_compiler" = gcc; then
  task_cxx=g++; task_flags=(-O0 -g0); unset ASAN_OPTIONS UBSAN_OPTIONS
 else
  task_cxx=clang++; task_flags=(-O1 -g0 -fsanitize=address,undefined,float-cast-overflow -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1 UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1
 fi
 sha256sum -c tests/fixtures/vfp9-listindex-numeric/fixed.sha256 > "build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-$task_phase-before-$task_compiler.log" || exit 3
 task_libraries=()
 for task_library in cf_xbase_runtime cf_design_model cf_prg_analysis cf_runtime_text cf_vfp_assets cf_platform_profile cf_security cf_localization cf_platform_support; do
  task_libraries+=("$task_build/lib$task_library.a")
 done
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 "$task_cxx" -std=c++20 "${task_flags[@]}" -Iinclude -Itests -Isrc/runtime -x c++ tests/fixtures/vfp9-listindex-numeric/ci-smoke-driver.cpp.txt -x none "$task_source" "$task_build/tests/CMakeFiles/cf_prg_engine_test_support.dir/prg_engine_test_support.cpp.o" "${task_libraries[@]}" -o "build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-$task_phase-$task_compiler" > "build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-$task_phase-compile-$task_compiler.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-$task_phase-compile-$task_compiler.status"
 test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 "build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-$task_phase-$task_compiler" > "build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-$task_phase-$task_compiler.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-$task_phase-$task_compiler.status"
 test "$task_status" -eq "$task_expected_status" || exit 4
 rg -F "ListIndex existing smoke completed: 1; failures: $task_expected_failures" "build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-$task_phase-$task_compiler.log" > /dev/null || exit 5
 sha256sum -c tests/fixtures/vfp9-listindex-numeric/fixed.sha256 > "build/listindex-native/ci-smoke-$task_phase-after-$task_compiler.log" || exit 6
done
